component.name: org.nuxeo.agentic.letters.processor
component.documentation: The add-on's template processor, agenticLetter, registered with the platform's template processor service, as the platform registers its own (Freemarker, XSLT, XDocReport). It fills a letter template's placeholders and runs nothing: a template is text and {{...}} placeholders, each a property of the record, one hop through a reference, or a letter value. It names no mime type and no extension, so the platform never chooses it for a file by itself; and it renders only while Letter.Generate writes a letter, and only that letter: rendered any other way, through the platform's TemplateProcessor.Render or a rendition, it refuses.
